dimensions.name: IS_LATEST_POLL
dimensions.comment: True for each season's most recent published week. THE definition of "current": filter this flag, never compute a max week.

dimensions.name: POLL_RANK
dimensions.comment: Position in the Top 25, 1 to 25. Ties are possible and produce two teams at one rank.

dimensions.name: RANK_CHANGE
dimensions.comment: Movement as a signed integer; positive means the team moved UP. NULL for no move or a new entry.

dimensions.name: RECORD_TEXT
dimensions.comment: The team's W-L record as published with the poll.

dimensions.name: SEASON
dimensions.comment: Poll season, 2024 onward. The 2026 season's first poll (the preseason poll) publishes in mid-August 2026.

dimensions.name: TREND_TEXT
dimensions.comment: Movement versus the prior week as the source spells it: '+3', '-1', or '-' for no move.

dimensions.name: WEEK
dimensions.comment: Poll week, 2-16. Week 2 is the preseason poll; there is no week-1 poll.

dimensions.name: CONFERENCE_NAME
dimensions.comment: The team's CURRENT conference (realignment history is not tracked on the team).

metrics.name: APPEARANCES
metrics.comment: Number of poll rows. Grouped by team, the number of weeks that team was ranked.

metrics.name: AVERAGE_RANK
metrics.comment: Average rank across the grouped poll rows.

metrics.name: BEST_RANK
metrics.comment: Best (numerically lowest) rank achieved in the grouping.

metrics.name: TOTAL_FIRST_PLACE_VOTES
metrics.comment: First-place votes summed across the grouped rows.
